I am sixty years old and have farmed these lands since I was a girl. I grow beans on this plot because they do well here and do not need costly fertilizer like maize does. I save my own seed from last season and will use it again. The beans suffer from insects, so I will buy a small amount of pesticide from the market to protect them. My children and grandchildren will help with the work, but the farm is too much for us alone, so I will hire a few young people to help during weeding and harvest.
